integrity: The nonexistence certificate and the rounded-point residual use exact rational arithmetic and depend only on equations and parameter labels present in the cited source.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the printed Gaussian moment map and the printed Figure 5–6 parameter labels; it does not infer which parameters were used in unavailable simulation code.
The result does not rule out transient or quasi-stationary behavior of the underlying stochastic process under the printed or other parameters.
title: The printed Monte Carlo validation point has no feasible positive moment equilibrium
